newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Big potential seen in Central Euro coffee market.
newsitem.headline: Big potential seen in Central Euro coffee market.

text.p: After heavy declines in 1994 and 1995, key Central European coffee markets are back on track toward solid growth, a regional marketing expert said.

"As coffee prices have come down, coffee markets are recovering and growing robustly in Central Europe," said Walter Struwe, head of coffee marketing for the European division of Kraft, Jacobs, Suchard.
He said Kraft Foods, the market leader in the European roast and ground coffee market, saw growth rates totalling 7.5 percent this year in regional sales of roast and ground coffee.
At the same time, growth in soluble coffee sales in Central Europe was seen totalling 17.4 percent, he said.

Struwe, who spoke in an address to the annual meeting of Colombia's National Coffee Exporters' Association, described Central and Eastern Europe as a market offering "enormous growth opportunities" for the coffee industry, especially as a time when consumption is declining or flat in traditional markets like the United States.
